title: File:Leukerbad vom Gemmipass.JPG
claims: The image is a high-angle daylight view from the Gemmi pass down into Leukerbad: the town fills a deep valley, with roads, a sports field, forested slopes and cliffs around it.

Commons titles the photograph Leukerbad vom Gemmipass, Leukerbad seen from the Gemmi pass; it shows the descent environment, not a race-day checkpoint, aid station, course marking, timing mat, start arch or finish line.
The author is Adrian Michael; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; the image date is August 2012; the original is 3,718 x 2,953 pixels and 3,319,965 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 762 copy of 282,662 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Adrian Michael, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
